app.tagline: Publishing, memberships, and community — on your own terms.
newsletters.archive_intro: Past issues sent to the community.
newsletters.archive_empty: No newsletters have gone out yet.
community.admin_only_hint: Admin only. Members do not see this.
community.announcements_empty_body: Official updates from the team will appear here.
community.empty_feed: It's quiet in here. Start the first conversation!
manage.nav_help: The primary menu appears in the site header. The footer has link columns and a bottom bar of small links.
manage.nav_primary_help: Shown in the site header. A dropdown holds links under one label.
manage.nav_columns_help: Each column is a heading with its own links. Your theme decides how the columns look.
manage.nav_bottom_bar_help: One row of small links at the very bottom — the classic spot for Terms and Privacy.
manage.nav_no_columns: No columns yet. Add one below, or start from the suggestion.
manage.nav_use_suggested: Add a starter column (Blog, Community, Newsletter)
manage.nav_theme_no_columns: Your current theme does not display link columns — only bottom bar links appear on the site. Columns you add are kept, and show again on a theme that supports them.
manage.nav_link_needs_destination: Pick a page or enter a URL for the link.
manage.title: Manage
manage.content_types_intro: Everything your organization publishes is one of these types. Each has its own place on your site and its own fields.
manage.coming_soon_intro: Premade types on the roadmap. They will appear here when the platform features they need are ready.
manage.presentation_hint: Site pages get your theme's header and footer — right for About, Team, or Pricing. Community pages render inside the member shell. Who can see the page is set by Visibility either way.
landing.intro: The words on your home page (the {theme} theme). The design comes from the theme; blank fields fall back to the placeholder text shown in each box.
manage.area_per_group: Selected groups — each group's own setting applies
manage.area_public: Everyone — the whole area is public
manage.area_members: Members only — the whole area is gated
manage.discussions_visibility_hint: In "selected groups" mode, each group below chooses public or members-only. The other modes override the per-group settings.
manage.gated_teasers_hint: When on, members-only content appears to visitors as locked titles with a members-only page behind them — a preview of what membership unlocks. When off, gated content is completely hidden from visitors.
manage.analytics_hint: Adds your analytics provider's script to every page of your site — public pages and the member community alike. The management console is never tracked. Visits are reported to the provider under your own account.
manage.analytics_plausible_script_url_hi: The src URL from the snippet in your Plausible dashboard (Site settings → Site installation). Self-hosted Plausible works too — paste your instance's script URL.
manage.analytics_plausible_site_domain_h: Only needed when your Plausible snippet uses a data-domain attribute (older self-hosted versions). Leave empty otherwise.
manage.analytics_ga4_measurement_id_hint: Looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX — find it in Google Analytics under Admin → Data streams → your web stream.
manage.analytics_fathom_site_id_hint: The short code from your Fathom dashboard's embed snippet (the data-site value).
manage.analytics_umami_script_url_hint: https://cloud.umami.is/script.js for Umami Cloud, or your self-hosted Umami's script URL.
manage.analytics_umami_website_id_hint: The data-website-id value from the tracking code in your Umami dashboard.
manage.analytics_field_invalid: {field} doesn't look right — copy it exactly from your provider's dashboard
manage.template_hint: Theme template name. Leave as 'page' unless your theme provides others.
manage.template_unknown: No template called "{name}" in this theme. Leave it empty to use the default page template.
manage.template_dropped: The template "{name}" is no longer allowed and has been cleared. This page now uses the default template.
manage.no_pages: No pages yet. Create your first page.
manage.upload_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, ICO or PDF. Max 10 MB. Images get thumb/medium/full variants.
manage.media_hint: Upload files under Media first, then select them here.
manage.theme_hint: Themes are installed at the installation level by Platform Admins.
manage.featured_image_hint: The numeric ID of an uploaded image from Media.
archive.title: Archive
members.invite_hint_no_email: No email service is configured — generate a link and send it however you like. Invitations never require email.
members.invite_hint_email: Enter an email to send the invitation directly, or leave it empty to just generate a link.
members.invite_link_once: This link is shown only once — only its hash is stored.
members.cannot_grant_owner: Only an owner can make someone an owner. Use Transfer ownership instead.
members.cannot_manage_higher_role: You cannot change the role of someone with more access than you. Ask an owner.
members.cannot_promote_self: You cannot give yourself a role with more access than you already have. Ask an owner, or use Transfer ownership.
members.user_not_found: No account with email {email}. Send them an invitation link instead.
members.invite_page_body: You have been invited to join {org} as {role}.
members.already_member: You are already a member of this organization.
members.account_exists: We couldn't create that account. If you already have one, log in first, then open the invitation link again.
discussions.title: Discussions
discussions.no_posts: No posts yet. Start the first one.
discussions.seeded_hint: Seeded at setup — only you can see this badge. Edit or delete it like any post.
discussions.followed: You are now following this post.
discussions.unfollowed: You are no longer following this post.
discussions.flagged: Thanks — a moderator will take a look.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.type_reply_followed: New reply on a post you follow
manage.flag_target_gone: The flagged content no longer exists.
newsletter.subscribed_body: You will receive updates from {org} by email.
newsletter.check_inbox_body: We sent a confirmation link to your email.
newsletter.unsubscribed_body: You will no longer receive emails.
newsletter.email_required_to_send: Configure email in Administration before sending newsletters. Web publishing works without it.
newsletter.no_email_banner: No email service configured: the subscribe form still collects your audience, but sending needs SMTP (Administration → Installation settings).
newsletter.confirm_body: Click below to confirm your subscription to {org}.
newsletter.form_hint: The public subscribe form lives at /subscribe on your site.
plugins.disabled: Plugin disabled. Its data is kept and re-enabling restores it.
plugins.none_available: No plugins are installed on this installation.
auth.register_body: Register to create and run your own organization.
auth.register_exists: We couldn't create that account. If you already have one, log in instead.
domains.title: Custom domains
domains.hint: Your organization is always reachable on its subdomain. Add an external domain here; a Platform Admin verifies and activates it.
domains.added: Domain added — awaiting activation by a Platform Admin.
domains.dns_hint: Point the domain's DNS (CNAME or A record) at this installation. HTTPS is handled by the reverse proxy (e.g. Caddy on_demand_tls).
admin.install_theme_warning: A theme package contains templates, which are code. Install only themes you trust — installing a theme is deploying code.
common.name: Name
orgs.launcher_empty: You do not belong to any organization yet.
orgs.launcher_empty_hint: Ask an administrator to add you to one.
orgs.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Used in the organization URL.
admin.title: Administration
admin.cannot_demote_self: You cannot change your own Platform Admin status.
admin.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
admin.allow_signups: Allow users to register and create their own organizations
admin.email_not_configured: No email service configured — Supremely remains fully operable without one.
admin.test_email_needs_address: Enter an address to send the test to.
admin.jobs_hint: Background work across the whole installation.
admin.jobs_none_failed: No failed jobs. Nothing needs your attention here.
setup.welcome_body: A few questions and you are running: your installation details, an administrator, and your first organization.
setup.base_url_hint: The public address of this installation, e.g. https://example.com
setup.invalid_base_url: That does not look like a valid URL.
setup.admin_username_hint: Fixed for every installation. Not an email address.
setup.admin_body: This account manages the installation. It works without any email service.
setup.password_too_short: Password must be at least {n} characters.
setup.password_too_common: That password is one of the most commonly used. Please choose another.
setup.org_body: An organization is the website or community you operate. You can also create it later from Administration.
setup.incomplete: Please complete the earlier steps first.
errors.403_body: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.500_body: An unexpected error occurred. It has been logged.
gate.explanation: This is shared with members of {org}. Some things here are public — this one isn't.
gate.not_member: Your account isn't a member of this community. Membership is by invitation.
